description:
Historical daily indicator snapshots for a stock, for charting and trend detection.
Returns up to `days` days (max 730, default 90) of the snapshots the indicator pipeline
takes once a day, oldest first.

Every snapshot row contains:
- recorded_at: the date of the snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). Rows are daily snapshots,
  not daily bars: a row can fall on a weekend, and a day is missing when no snapshot ran.
- price: the quote when the snapshot was taken (it can be an intraday or after-hours
  price), or that day's close for rows rebuilt from the price history. For exact daily
  closes use get_stock_history.
- The indicators below are as of the newest daily bar available when the row was
  written: often the session before recorded_at, for rebuilt rows that day's own
  session. A row's values therefore do not always match the bar of its date.
- rsi: RSI(14) value (0-100)
- macd_histogram: MACD histogram value (positive = upward momentum)
- bb_pct: Bollinger Band % position of that row's price (0 = at lower, 100 = at upper band)
- sma20 / sma200: 20-day and 200-day simple moving averages

With full=true, each row also gets:
- williams_r: Williams %R (0 to -100; >-20 overbought, <-80 oversold)
- ultimate_osc: Ultimate Oscillator (0-100; >70 overbought, <30 oversold)
- vix_fix_value: Williams VIX Fix synthetic fear gauge (higher = more fear)
- williams_ad_trend: Accumulation/Distribution trend (rising/falling/flat)
- td_signal: DeMark TD Sequential count, named for the move that is running out
  (DOWNTREND_EXHAUSTION_SETUP / UPTREND_EXHAUSTION_SETUP /
  DOWNTREND_EXHAUSTION_COUNTDOWN / UPTREND_EXHAUSTION_COUNTDOWN / null)
- td_phase: DeMark phase (setup_active/setup_complete/countdown_active/countdown_done/null)
- analyst_rating: analyst consensus (buy/outperform/hold/underperform/sell or null)
- analyst_target: mean analyst price target or null

With fewer than 3 snapshots in the window: count 0, an empty snapshots list and a note.
Pro tier only.
For informational purposes only. Not financial advice.

days.description: Number of calendar days to look back (max 730, default 90). With fewer than 3 snapshots in the window the response has count 0, an empty snapshots list and a note.

full.description: False (default) returns only recorded_at/price/rsi/macd_histogram/bb_pct/sma20/sma200 per day - enough for most charting/trend use. True adds the specialized indicators (williams_r, ultimate_osc, vix_fix_value, williams_ad_trend, td_signal, td_phase) plus analyst_rating/analyst_target, which barely change day to day and roughly double response size over a long window.

symbol.description: Stock ticker symbol. Also accepts a company name as a fallback when it uniquely resolves to one symbol.
